about: 78 hook structures for posts, emails and talks. Major Arcana are big-idea hooks. Cups are story and feeling. Wands are contrarian and bold. Swords are questions and challenges. Pentacles are numbers, proof and results.
example_founder: Every example is written as Wren, a fictional breathwork teacher who runs small retreats. Her numbers are invented to show the shape. Use your own true numbers.
